datasets.subject: hardware
datasets.preprocessingNotes: 3 single-row corrupted timestamps (0-based rows 1898, 2066, 2253 in the source file) repaired by linear interpolation from their neighbours - this is one continuous 206.8s recording, NOT several concatenated sessions. Row 0 (startup glitch, ir~82.7k vs ~115k everywhere else) dropped. Resampled 16.667Hz -> 25Hz via scipy.signal.resample_poly(x, 3, 2, padtype='line'); padtype='line' matters - the default zero padding collapses the last window's DC and made R jump to ~0.98. Green LED is effectively off (0-134 counts) - column kept but not used for anything. Red perfusion index is ~1/3 of IR (median PI_IR ~0.20%, PI_RED ~0.073%): most SpO2 windows read above the generic curve's 100% ceiling and are rejected - a real hardware finding (red LED under-driven), not a processing bug.

datasets.subject: hardware
datasets.preprocessingNotes: Exported from this app's own History (single-wavelength capture, ir only - SpO2 needs red AND ir from the same instant, see estimate_spo2.m). accMagnitude in the source export is a scalar sqrt(x^2+y^2+z^2), not per-axis data, so accX/Y/Z are written as 0 here rather than fabricated - the LMS motion-artifact filter gets no real reference on playback of this dataset (accMagnitude was already 0 throughout the original capture, i.e. the accelerometer likely wasn't wired/initialised on the firmware at capture time - see the Phase 0 report). bpm/cleanedPpg from the original export are not reused; the app recomputes them fresh from ir on playback.
